raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add an opt-in automatic deployment namespace to MooncakeStoreConnector so code or configuration changes can invalidate shared KV cache without a manually calculated prefix.

## Claims

- `kv_connector_extra_config.cache_prefix="auto"` derives a full SHA-256 prefix from build identity, effective configuration, and relevant environment settings.
- Custom prefixes and the empty default retain their behavior. Scheduler capacities and derived batch sizes do not change the namespace.
- Composed online quantization is supported; its runtime timers and layer inventory are excluded.

## Validation

- 34 configuration/key regression tests passed: `python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/config tests/config/test_mooncake_cache_prefix.py -k 'not test_llm' -q` in a temporary uv-managed Python 3.12 environment on macOS.
- The new online-quantization regressions reproduced three failures before the serializer fix and passed afterward.
- 6 existing Docker build-metadata tests passed: `python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/tools tests/tools/test_docker_build_metadata_args.py -q`.
- All pre-commit hooks passed, including Ruff, mypy, documentation lint, and Buildkite test wiring; `git diff --check` passed. A Buildkite step includes the full suite and the real `LLM` startup regression.
- GPU startup, real Mooncake transfers, model-output evaluations, and performance benchmarks have not been run locally. This is a draft starting point for review and GPU validation; no accuracy or performance improvement is claimed.

## Details

The worker resolves the prefix once before Store initialization. Public release builds already embed `VLLM_IMAGE_TAG` and `VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT`; custom builds must supply an immutable image identity or a known commit. Missing/default development identities fail startup in automatic mode.

`cache_prefix.py` contains the fingerprint logic and explicit exclusions. Worker integration is limited to resolving the existing metadata field. The docs explain enablement and compatibility; tests cover stable replica keys, invalidation, batching exclusions, environment filtering, and nested quantization.

Isolation is conservative and can partition compatible deployments. The exact string `auto` becomes reserved. Live weight updates or overwriting weights without changing their identity are not detected. Unregistered plugin variables outside the documented environment families must be represented in configuration or added to the fingerprint.

Related upstream work: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56971 fingerprints the resolved Store payload format and changes the default key format. This draft adds a separate opt-in deployment namespace that also changes with code/image identity and environment settings while preserving the default and literal custom prefixes. It complements payload-format compatibility checks rather than implementing the decode-phase Mamba/GDN fixes in that PR.

This upstream draft replaces the starting-point PR at https://github.com/hj-mistral/vllm/pull/2. The signed branch predates current upstream main by 40 commits; a merge-tree check against upstream commit `30565c39372c08b91d164779a120b1f3ba77dc85` reported no conflicts. GPU/Store validation remains outstanding before review readiness.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill.
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Isolates the feature in the MooncakeStore path and reuses configuration normalization and hashing utilities.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Local configuration tests pass; full GPU/Store validation remains outstanding.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Includes documentation and meaningful regression coverage.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes motivation, evidence, compatibility notes, related work, and validation limits.
</details>

@@ -326,11 +326,67 @@ Strict isolation requires a Mooncake master started with `--enable_multi_tenants
   `"NVLINK"` is used in the [EGM deployment example](#standalone-egm-over-nvlink);
   `"BAREX"` selects the BAR-exposed allocator. Unset by default. Both are
   incompatible with sleep mode and the CuMem allocator.
-- `cache_prefix` (str): Namespace prepended to every store key. Lets separate deployments share one Mooncake master without polluting each other — instances configured with different prefixes never see each other's cached blocks, even for identical prompts. All instances that should share a prefix cache must use the same value. Default: `""` (no prefix; keys are byte-identical to the unprefixed format).
+- `cache_prefix` (str): Namespace prepended to every store key. Different prefixes isolate cached blocks, even for identical prompts. Set to `"auto"` to derive a deployment fingerprint automatically (see below). Other strings remain literal custom prefixes. Default: `""` (no prefix; existing key format).
 - `save_decode_cache` (bool): Enable offloading decode tokens' KV cache. A `kv_consumer` does not save during prefill; when decode starts, it fills any missing block-aligned prompt prefix before appending completed decode blocks. Default: `false`.
 - `store_tp_size` (int): Common Store TP for divisible heterogeneous-TP
   sharing. See [Sharing one Store across multiple Prefill TP sizes](#sharing-one-store-across-multiple-prefill-tp-sizes).
 
+#### Automatic cache prefix
+
+Enable automatic namespacing for **MooncakeStoreConnector** with:
+
+```json
+{
+  "kv_connector": "MooncakeStoreConnector",
+  "kv_role": "kv_both",
+  "kv_connector_extra_config": {"cache_prefix": "auto"}
+}
+```
+
+vLLM replaces `"auto"` with `auto-<SHA-256>` in every Store key and logs the
+resolved prefix. The fingerprint includes `VLLM_IMAGE_TAG`, `VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT`,
+the vLLM version, resolved model and quantization configuration, compute
+configuration hashes, loading and scheduling settings, and KV-cache and Store
+payload format settings. Scheduler capacities (`max_num_batched_tokens`,
+`max_num_seqs`, queue limits and derived CUDA graph batch sizes) are excluded.
+Changing these limits therefore preserves the namespace; batching itself can
+still introduce numerical differences when recomputing KV.
+Online quantization uses its declared arguments, including when composed with
+checkpoint quantization; loading timers and the runtime layer inventory are
+excluded.
+
+The environment fingerprint includes registered vLLM settings with their parsed
+defaults, unregistered `VLLM_*` settings, `NCCL_*`, `CUBLAS_*`, `CUBLASLT_*`,
+`FLASHINFER_*`, `TRITON_*`, `NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE` and `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`.
+Explicit exclusions remove credentials, logging, ranks, ports and runtime cache
+directories. Invalid registered values fail startup rather than being skipped.
+Unrelated environment variables are not hashed; plugin settings outside these
+names must be represented in the vLLM configuration or added to the fingerprint
+before relying on automatic isolation. Engine IDs, Store addresses and
+producer/consumer roles do not affect the prefix.
+
+Official public release builds already pass both build identity arguments using
+`.buildkite/scripts/docker-build-metadata-args.sh`. For a custom Docker build,
+pass `--build-arg VLLM_IMAGE_TAG=<immutable-image-reference>` and
+`--build-arg VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT=<source-commit>`. Docker's `--tag` alone does not
+set the environment inside the image.
+
+Set an immutable `VLLM_IMAGE_TAG` or a known `VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT`. Startup fails
+when both are missing or only the default development identity is available.
+Rebuilding a mutable tag such as `latest` without changing the build identity
+cannot invalidate cached KV. Likewise, pin model revisions and replace the
+model identity when overwriting local weights; this feature does not hash
+weight files or detect live weight updates.
+
+Changing the code identity, quantization, KV dtype or other fingerprinted
+settings makes existing cached blocks invisible to the new deployment. Old
+blocks remain in Mooncake until normal eviction. Identically configured
+replicas share the fingerprint. Isolation is conservative: different compute
+settings (including TP sizes) may prevent reuse even when their Store payloads
+are compatible. Use a shared custom prefix when deliberately enabling such
+reuse. The exact string `"auto"` is now reserved; every other custom prefix and
+the empty default keep their previous behavior.
+
 LBHNC/HND is strongly recommended for TP-sharded Store when supported. LBNHC/NHD
 creates many transfer segments and may significantly reduce PUT/GET performance.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from transformers import OPTConfig
+
+from vllm.config import (
+    CacheConfig,
+    DeviceConfig,
+    KVTransferConfig,
+    ModelConfig,
+    SchedulerConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+)
+from vllm.config.quantization import QuantizationConfigArgs
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.mooncake.store.cache_prefix import (  # noqa: E501
+    resolve_cache_prefix,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.mooncake.store.layout import (  # noqa: E501
+    KeyMetadata,
+    PoolKey,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8Config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.base import OnlineQuantizationConfig
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tests.conftest import VllmRunner
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def model_path(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
+    OPTConfig(
+        hidden_size=64,
+        num_hidden_layers=2,
+        num_attention_heads=4,
+        ffn_dim=128,
+        word_embed_proj_dim=64,
+    ).save_pretrained(tmp_path)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_IMAGE_TAG", "vllm:test-build-1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT", "unknown")
+    return tmp_path
+
+
+def make_config(model_path: Path, **kwargs: Any) -> VllmConfig:
+    return VllmConfig(
+        model_config=ModelConfig(model=str(model_path), dtype="float16"),
+        device_config=DeviceConfig("cpu"),
+        kv_transfer_config=KVTransferConfig(
+            kv_connector="MooncakeStoreConnector",
+            kv_role="kv_both",
+            kv_connector_extra_config={"cache_prefix": "auto"},
+        ),
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+def pool_key(config: VllmConfig) -> str:
+    return PoolKey(
+        KeyMetadata("model", 0, 0, 0, 0, cache_prefix=resolve_cache_prefix(config)),
+        "same-prompt-hash",
+    ).to_string()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("prefix", ["", "custom-fp4", "AUTO"])
+def test_literal_prefix_keeps_existing_keys(model_path: Path, prefix: str) -> None:
+    config = make_config(model_path)
+    assert config.kv_transfer_config is not None
+    config.kv_transfer_config.kv_connector_extra_config["cache_prefix"] = prefix
+    expected = PoolKey(
+        KeyMetadata("model", 0, 0, 0, 0, cache_prefix=prefix), "same-prompt-hash"
+    ).to_string()
+    assert pool_key(config) == expected
+
+
+def test_replicas_share_keys_despite_runtime_identity(model_path: Path) -> None:
+    first, second = make_config(model_path), make_config(model_path)
+    assert first.kv_transfer_config is not None
+    assert second.kv_transfer_config is not None
+    assert first.instance_id != second.instance_id
+    assert first.kv_transfer_config.engine_id != second.kv_transfer_config.engine_id
+    second.parallel_config.rank = 1
+    second.parallel_config.master_port += 1
+    second.kv_transfer_config.kv_role = "kv_consumer"
+    second.kv_transfer_config.kv_connector_extra_config["lookup_rpc_port"] = 54321
+    second.cache_config.num_gpu_blocks = 200
+    assert pool_key(first) == pool_key(second)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "variable", ["VLLM_IMAGE_TAG", "VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT", "VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT"]
+)
+def test_code_or_compute_environment_change_isolates_keys(
+    model_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, variable: str
+) -> None:
+    config = make_config(model_path)
+    old_key = pool_key(config)
+    monkeypatch.setenv(variable, "1")
+    assert pool_key(config) != old_key
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "cache_kwargs",
+    [
+        {"cache_dtype": "fp8"},
+        {"block_size": 32},
+        {"prefix_caching_hash_algo": "sha256_cbor"},
+    ],
+)
+def test_cache_format_change_isolates_keys(
+    model_path: Path, cache_kwargs: dict[str, Any]
+) -> None:
+    assert pool_key(make_config(model_path)) != pool_key(
+        make_config(model_path, cache_config=CacheConfig(**cache_kwargs))
+    )
+
+
+def test_model_config_and_loader_changes_isolate_keys(model_path: Path) -> None:
+    config = make_config(model_path)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project

+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import fields
+from typing import Any
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm import __version__
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.config.utils import (
+    SupportsHash,
+    get_hash_factors,
+    hash_factors,
+    normalize_value,
+)
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizationConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.base import OnlineQuantizationConfig
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _environment_factors() -> dict[str, object]:
+    ignored = {
+        "VLLM_API_KEY",
+        "VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT",  # Included explicitly in the deployment identity.
+        "VLLM_IMAGE_TAG",
+        "VLLM_BUILD_PIPELINE",
+        "VLLM_BUILD_URL",
+        "VLLM_HOST_IP",
+        "VLLM_PORT",
+        "VLLM_DP_MASTER_IP",
+        "VLLM_DP_MASTER_PORT",
+        "VLLM_DP_RANK",
+        "VLLM_DP_RANK_LOCAL",
+        "VLLM_RAY_BUNDLE_INDICES",
+        "VLLM_RAY_DP_PLACEMENT_NODE_IPS",
+        "VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH",
+        "VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST",
+        "VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT",
+        "VLLM_EC_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST",
+        "VLLM_EC_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT",
+        "VLLM_MOONCAKE_BOOTSTRAP_PORT",
+        "VLLM_LOOPBACK_IP",
+        "VLLM_CACHE_ROOT",
+        "VLLM_CONFIG_ROOT",
+        "VLLM_XLA_CACHE_PATH",
+        "VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE_DIR",
+        "VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD",
+        "VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING",
+        "VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL",
+        "VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS",
+        "VLLM_DO_NOT_TRACK",
+        "VLLM_USAGE_STATS_SERVER",
+        "TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR",
+        "TRITON_CACHE_DIR",
+    }
+    library_prefixes = ("NCCL_", "CUBLAS_", "CUBLASLT_", "FLASHINFER_", "TRITON_")
+    library_names = {"NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE", "LD_LIBRARY_PATH"}
+    names = set(envs.environment_variables) | set(os.environ) | library_names
+    factors: dict[str, object] = {}
+    for name in sorted(names):
+        if name in ignored or name.startswith("VLLM_LOGGING_"):
+            continue
+        if not (name.startswith(("VLLM_", *library_prefixes)) or name in library_names):
+            continue
+        # Use parsed defaults for registered settings. Unknown vLLM/plugin and
+        # library flags use their raw value. Invalid getters must fail startup.
+        getter = envs.environment_variables.get(name)
+        try:
+            factors[name] = normalize_value(
+                getter() if getter else os.environ.get(name)
+            )
+        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Invalid {name} for MooncakeStore's automatic cache prefix"
+            ) from exc
+    return factors
+
+
+def _quantization_json_default(value: object) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, QuantizationConfig):
+        # Online config args describe quantization; loading timers and the
+        # per-process inventory of quantized layers do not affect KV compatibility.
+        state = (
+            {"args": value.args}
+            if isinstance(value, OnlineQuantizationConfig)
+            else vars(value)
+        )
+        return {"type": normalize_value(type(value)), "state": state}
+    if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
+        return value.model_dump(mode="json")
+    return normalize_value(value)
+
+
+def resolve_cache_prefix(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> str:
+    """Namespace Store KV by deployment identity when cache_prefix is 'auto'."""
+    transfer_config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+    assert transfer_config is not None, "MooncakeStore requires KVTransferConfig"
+    extra_config = transfer_config.kv_connector_extra_config
+    prefix = str(extra_config.get("cache_prefix", ""))
+    if prefix != "auto":
+        return prefix
+
+    image_tag = envs.VLLM_IMAGE_TAG.strip()
+    build_commit = envs.VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT.strip()
+    if build_commit in ("", "unknown") and image_tag in (
+        "",
+        "local/vllm-openai:dev",
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MooncakeStore cache_prefix='auto' requires VLLM_BUILD_COMMIT "
+            "or an immutable VLLM_IMAGE_TAG identifying the deployed code."
+        )
+
+    # Use component hashes, not VllmConfig's truncated compilation hash.
+    # Their runtime exclusions keep engine IDs, ranks and ports out of the key.
+    config_factors: dict[str, object] = {}
+    ignored = {
+        "instance_id",
+        "kv_transfer_config",
+        "ec_transfer_config",
+        "kv_events_config",
+        "observability_config",
+        "logging_config",
+        "profiler_config",
+        "watchdog_config",
+        "shutdown_timeout",
+        "weight_transfer_config",
+    }
+    hashed_separately = {
+        "model_config",
+        "load_config",
+        "scheduler_config",
+        "compilation_config",
+        "quant_config",
+    }
+    for config_field in fields(vllm_config):
+        name = config_field.name
+        if name in ignored or name in hashed_separately:
+            continue
+        value = getattr(vllm_config, name)
+        config_factors[name] = (
+            value.compute_hash()
+            if isinstance(value, SupportsHash)
+            else normalize_value(value)
+        )
+
+    # Include declared settings by default, excluding capacity and runtime state.
+    config_factors["load_config"] = get_hash_factors(
+        vllm_config.load_config, {"download_dir", "use_tqdm_on_load"}
+    )
+    config_factors["scheduler_config"] = get_hash_factors(
+        vllm_config.scheduler_config,
+        {
+            "max_num_batched_tokens",
+            "max_num_scheduled_tokens",
+            "max_num_seqs",
+            "max_num_active_seqs",
+            "max_num_queued_reqs",
+            "max_num_queued_tokens",
+            "max_num_encoder_input_tokens",
+            "encoder_cache_size",
+        },
+    )
+    compilation = vllm_config.compilation_config
+    config_factors["compilation_config"] = get_hash_factors(
+        compilation,
+        {
+            "debug_dump_path",
+            "cache_dir",
+            "local_cache_dir",
+            "traced_files",
+            "compilation_time",
+            "encoder_compilation_time",
+            "enabled_custom_ops",
+            "disabled_custom_ops",
+            "static_forward_context",
+            "pass_config",
+            "dynamic_shapes_config",
+            # Capture/compile batch sizes are derived from scheduler capacities.
+            "compile_sizes",
+            "compile_ranges_endpoints",
+            "cudagraph_capture_sizes",
+            "max_cudagraph_capture_size",
+            "decoder_replay_cudagraph_capture_sizes",
+        },
+    )
+    config_factors["compilation_passes"] = compilation.pass_config.compute_hash()
+    config_factors["dynamic_shapes"] = compilation.dynamic_shapes_config.compute_hash()
+    quantization = vllm_config.quant_config
+    config_factors["quant_config"] = (
+        json.dumps(
+            quantization,
+            default=_quantization_json_default,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+        )
+        if quantization is not None
+        else None
+    )
+    model = vllm_config.model_config
+    if model is not None:
+        config_factors["model_config"] = get_hash_factors(
+            model,
+            {
+                "hf_token",
+                "hf_overrides",  # Resolved HF configs are already model fields.
+            },
+        )
+        config_factors["hf_commit_hash"] = getattr(
+            model.hf_config, "_commit_hash", None
+        )
+    parallel = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    config_factors["parallel_compute_options"] = normalize_value(
+        {
+            "disable_custom_all_reduce": parallel.disable_custom_all_reduce,
+            "worker_cls": parallel.worker_cls,
+            "worker_extension_cls": parallel.worker_extension_cls,
+        }
+    )
+    config_factors["prefix_caching_hash_algo"] = (
+        vllm_config.cache_config.prefix_caching_hash_algo
+    )
+    config_factors["hash_block_size"] = vllm_config.cache_config.hash_block_size
+    config_factors["prefix_match_unit"] = vllm_config.cache_config.prefix_match_unit
+    config_factors["store_format_options"] = normalize_value(
+        {
+            name: extra_config.get(name)
+            for name in (
+                "enable_cross_layers_blocks",
+                "store_tp_size",
+                "enable_store_tp_lcm",
+                "prefill_tp_sizes",
+                "store_chunk_size",
+            )
+        }
+    )
+    factors = {
+        "schema": "vllm-mooncake-store-auto-v1",
+        "vllm_version": __version__,
+        "image_tag": image_tag,
+        "build_commit": build_commit,
+        "config": config_factors,
+        "env": _environment_factors(),
+    }
+    prefix = f"auto-{hash_factors(factors)}"
+    logger.info("MooncakeStore resolved cache_prefix: %s", prefix)
+    return prefix
